Hi Sophie / Jim —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery:

- Goal: run a 6-week pilot of Redwood hosted inference for Acme's customer support reranking pipeline.
- Success criteria: match current quality while reducing per-token cost by >=30% and keeping 95th pct latency under 400ms.
- Scope: up to 20M tokens/month, integration via API + a shared S3 input for eval sets.
- Internal stakeholders: Sophie (Product), Jim (Legal), Maya (Procurement).

Next steps I promised on the call:
1) Share draft SOW + contract with our standard redlines (attached).
2) Provide an eval checklist + sample prompts for your infra team.
3) Set up a tech sync next week with your engineering lead.

I'm attaching the draft SOW and our proposed redlines for your counsel to review (Acme_Redlines_v1.docx, SOW_Acme_v2.pdf). Can you confirm the best contact for procurement PO timing? If procurement prefers an SOW-first or PO-first process, we'll accommodate.

Happy to jump on a short call with counsel to walk through any redlines.

Thanks,
